title: Feature request: Add a meal type/category for Carbs treatments
body:
The Freestyle Libre app supports 'Meal, Breakfast, Lunch, Diner and snacks' during adding a note about carbohydrates.
It would be nice to have some likewise functionality to register not only the number of carbs but also what meal type/ category it was for analysis and comparison of different bolus styles at a later moment.

I'd rather not use a fixed list of 'Meal, Breakfast, Lunch, Diner and snacks' but a configurable list.

comments.body: @bert1973 Would you please explain what you will be able to do, after this, that you cannot do now?

Maybe I use an old version, but I can only enter the number of carbs. The enhancement I ask for is to introduce a posibility to add some (configurable) mealtype lets say 'pasta' or 'rice'. So that after a longer period I would be able to take all data from days which hold a meal of type 'pasta' or 'rice' to compare impact of bolus style.

Thanks.  I understand now I think.
So, we have to add the capability to add the meal time on the carb entry form; and we also have to add the capability to analyze the data later on to create graphs or charts to show correlations between meal types and glucose.  Just entering the meal type will not be enough.

Just to confirm my understanding is correct, I would like to ask another question.
As a work-around, can you create a spreadsheet; add in adjacent columns, date, time, meal type, exercise, insulin, glucose.
Then, you can use statistical analysis to produce a plethora of graphs.
Will that work?

There is no end in how far you can go with expanding your spreadsheet.  I mean, for example, you can distinguish between what types of exercise you take part in.  For example, how riding a bicycle affects your glucose may be different than how skiing will affect it, the same way how rice and pasta affect your glucose differently.
It gets significantly worse for women due to the impact of hormones on glucose.

If I understand you correctly, your suggestion would complicate xDrip too much.
For me a meal type would be enough, as I planned to copy the db from my device after a period and run sql queries against it. Ofcourse graphs in xDrip would be great but way too much work for you.
Would it be sufficient to have at least a note field in the treatment dialog?

i guess using the notes will be enough for analysis in sql later.
The Accu Chek Guide device has small symbols for these types, like moon, full apple, half apple, , star and so on, which would also be the "note"

You can add a note to a treatment.  Just tap on the treatment.  An option "Add note" will appear at the bottom of the screen for a few seconds.  if you tap on it, you will be able to add a note.

There is an option under the main menu that let's you search notes.

It seems to me what is requested is already there.
Please let me know if it is not.  
We can always reopen if needed.
